scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test:billing: NODE_ENV=test sh -c 'out=test/.billing-flow.test.mjs; trap "rm -f $out" EXIT; esbuild test/billing-flow.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bannerCreateRequire } from '\''node:module'\''; import * as __bannerPath from '\''node:path'\''; import * as __bannerUrl from '\''node:url'\''; const require = __bannerCreateRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = __bannerUrl.fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = __bannerPath.dirname(__filename);" --outfile="$out" --external:stripe --external:stripe-replit-sync --external:pino --external:pino-http --external:pino-pretty --external:thread-stream && node --test "$out"'
scripts.test:e-invoicing-certificate-safety: NODE_ENV=test sh -c 'out=test/.e-invoicing-certificate-safety.test.mjs; trap "rm -f $out" EXIT; esbuild test/e-invoicing-certificate-safety.test.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bannerCreateRequire } from '\''node:module'\''; const require = __bannerCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile="$out" --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pino --external:pino-http --external:pino-pretty --external:thread-stream --external:stripe --external:stripe-replit-sync && node --test "$out"'
